papers.title_en: PARD-SSM: Probabilistic Cyber-Attack Regime Detection via Variational Switching State-Space Models
papers.authors: Prakul Sunil Hiremath, PeerAhammad M Bagawan, Sahil Bhekane
papers.evidence: 非平稳动态中的状态检测与异常评分
papers.tldr: 针对现代网络攻击多阶段且隐蔽的特点，本文提出PARD-SSM框架，利用变分切换状态空间模型将网络遥测数据建模为包含四个隐藏状态的动力系统。该方法通过结构化变分近似和在线EM算法实现了高效的实时检测与阶段识别，在保持极高F1分数的同时，能提前约8分钟发出攻击预警，显著提升了入侵检测系统的透明度和预见性。
papers.abstract_en: Modern adversarial campaigns unfold as sequences of behavioural phases - Reconnaissance, Lateral Movement, Intrusion, and Exfiltration - each often indistinguishable from legitimate traffic when viewed in isolation. Existing intrusion detection systems (IDS) fail to capture this structure: signature-based methods cannot detect zero-day attacks, deep-learning models provide opaque anomaly scores without stage attribution, and standard Kalman Filters cannot model non-stationary multi-modal dynamics. We present PARD-SSM, a probabilistic framework that models network telemetry as a Regime-Dependent Switching Linear Dynamical System with K = 4 hidden regimes. A structured variational approximation reduces inference complexity from exponential to O(TK^2), enabling real-time detection on standard CPU hardware. An online EM algorithm adapts model parameters, while KL-divergence gating suppresses false positives. Evaluated on CICIDS2017 and UNSW-NB15, PARD-SSM achieves F1 scores of 98.2% and 97.1%, with latency less than 1.2 ms per flow. The model also produces predictive alerts approximately 8 minutes before attack onset, a capability absent in prior systems.

papers.title_en: Energy Score-Guided Neural Gaussian Mixture Model for Predictive Uncertainty Quantification
papers.authors: Yang Yang, Chunlin Ji, Haoyang Li, Ke Deng
papers.evidence: 通过神经高斯混合模型实现可解释预测
papers.tldr: 针对机器学习中预测不确定性量化面临的训练不稳定和模式崩溃问题，本文提出了一种基于能量评分引导的神经高斯混合模型（NE-GMM）。该方法结合了高斯混合模型捕捉复杂多峰分布的灵活性与能量评分的鲁棒性，以增强预测的校准度。通过理论证明其损失函数的严格适当性及泛化误差界限，实验验证了该模型在预测准确性和不确定性量化方面的优越性能。
papers.abstract_en: Quantifying predictive uncertainty is essential for real world machine learning applications, especially in scenarios requiring reliable and interpretable predictions. Many common parametric approaches rely on neural networks to estimate distribution parameters by optimizing the negative log likelihood. However, these methods often encounter challenges like training instability and mode collapse, leading to poor estimates of the mean and variance of the target output distribution. In this work, we propose the Neural Energy Gaussian Mixture Model (NE-GMM), a novel framework that integrates Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) with Energy Score (ES) to enhance predictive uncertainty quantification. NE-GMM leverages the flexibility of GMM to capture complex multimodal distributions and leverages the robustness of ES to ensure well calibrated predictions in diverse scenarios. We theoretically prove that the hybrid loss function satisfies the properties of a strictly proper scoring rule, ensuring alignment with the true data distribution, and establish generalization error bounds, demonstrating that the model's empirical performance closely aligns with its expected performance on unseen data. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real world datasets demonstrate the superiority of NE-GMM in terms of both predictive accuracy and uncertainty quantification.

papers.title_en: Selective State-Space Models for Koopman-based Data-driven Distribution System State Estimation
papers.evidence: 用于时变行为推断的选择性状态空间模型
papers.tldr: 针对现代配电网中分布式能源集成带来的状态估计（DSSE）难题，本文提出MambaDSSE框架。该方法结合了Koopman理论概率滤波与选择性状态空间模型（Mamba），实现了无模型的数据驱动推理。实验证明，该模型在处理长程依赖、应对DER渗透及采样不规律方面显著优于传统机器学习方法，提升了DSSE的扩展性和鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Distribution System State Estimation (DSSE) plays an increasingly-important role in modern power grids due to the integration of distributed energy resources (DERs). The inherent characteristics of distribution systems make classical estimation methods struggle, and recent advancements in data-driven learning methods, although promising, exhibit systematic failure in generalization and scalability that limits their applicability. In this work, we propose MambaDSSE, a model-free data-driven framework that incorporates Koopman-theoretic probabilistic filtering with a selective state-space model that learn to infer the underlying time-varying behavior of the system from data. We evaluate the model across a variety of test systems and scenarios, and demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms machine learning baselines on scalability, resilience to DER penetration levels, and robustness to data sampling rate irregularities. We further highlight the Mamba-based SSM's ability to capture long range dependencies from data, improving performance on the DSSE task.

papers.title_en: A Robbins-Monro algorithm for non-parametric estimation of NAR process with Markov-Switching: asymptotic normality
papers.authors: Lisandro Fermin, Ricardo Rios, Luis-Ángel Rodríguez
papers.evidence: 非线性自回归过程的非参数估计
papers.tldr: 本研究针对具有马尔可夫切换的非线性自回归（MS-NAR）过程，探讨了其非参数回归函数的估计问题。在前期研究证明模型一致性的基础上，本文提出了一种基于Robbins-Monro算法的恢复-估计方法，并重点推导了该非参数估计量在马尔可夫链可观测及不可观测两种情况下的渐近正态性（中心极限定理），最后通过仿真验证了算法性能。
papers.abstract_en: This paper is the second part of our study on the non-parametric estimation of MS-NAR processes started with [L. Fermin et al. 2017]. We consider the Nadaraya-Watson type regression function estimator for non-linear autoregressive Markov switching processes. In this context the regression function estimator is interpreted as a solution of a local weighted We have introduced, in the first work, a restoration-estimation Robbins-Monro algorithm to approximate the estimator, and we proved identifiability of model and the consistency of the non-parametric estimator. In this work, we obtain the central limit theorem for the non-parametric estimator, whether the Markov chain is observed or not. Finally, we present a detailed simulation study illustrating the performances of our estimation procedure.
